_status: Four-colour kit + flash beat APPROVED 2026-10-29. All colours measured (WCAG) and recorded. 'approved': false items still need V0 confirmation before render lock.

accent.role: keyword highlight, key numbers, CTA pill, progress fill

secondary.role: cards, icons, bar fills, secondary UI

surface.role: card surface, slightly lighter than bg

rules: Accent text ON bg is 12.1:1 - safe for all sizes.
Negative #FF6B4A text never goes on bg (5.2:1 OK only for <=24px); use as fill or strikethrough.
Purple never as small text on bg (3.19:1 fails); purple is a fill/shape colour.
Lime is the 'bad/warning' escape from dark-only look ONLY in flash beats (1-2/reel).

flash_beat.rule: 1-2 per reel maximum. Full screen lime (#B6FF00), big dark number, payoff moment (frame 2 of the reel).
flash_beat.purpose: thumb-stop, signature, spoken-word highlight; separates the brand from dark 'crypto/trading' looks.
flash_beat.limits: at most 2 per reel; never full-lime for the whole reel.

traps_and_fixes_recorded.trap1_flat_dark: 60 s of near-black feels flat and blends with app dark UI.
traps_and_fixes_recorded.fix1: 1-2 lime flash beats per reel (full screen + big dark number) - see flash_beat above.
traps_and_fixes_recorded.trap2_no_bad_state: Palette had no 'bad' signal - a $275->$0 price swap or warning could not be shown.
traps_and_fixes_recorded.trap3_crypto_drift: Dark + neon lime reads as crypto/trading channels.
traps_and_fixes_recorded.fix3: Face frame kept large; lime only on spoken words; card animations bouncy, not corporate.
traps_and_fixes_recorded.gap_gen_alpha: Gen Alpha prefers brighter, louder, faster (Roblox/MrBeast-style).
traps_and_fixes_recorded.fix3b: reduce card swaps to 2-3 s; keep palette to three colours plus coral.

font.verified: Arabic block glyphs 73; Western digits and $ , . % : present
